The '''book of the dead''' is an equipable book obtained as a reward from completing [[A Kingdom Divided]]. Having it equipped or in the player's inventory is required when casting [[resurrection spells]].

The book is an improved version of [[Kharedst's memoirs]], and offers the same teleports. The book offers as an additional 150 charges over the memories, resulting in a maximum of 250 charges if all five of the [[Page (Kharedst's memoirs)|pages]] from the [[Quests/Series#Kourend|original Kourend quests]] have been added.

If lost, the book can be reclaimed from [[Commander Fullore]] on the ground floor of the [[Kourend Castle]]. Additional copies can be purchased from [[Perdu]] for {{Coins|9500}} coins each.
